zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

tpm_judge.persona_contract: Legendary TPM judge accountable for enforcing the new audit bead after a closed run and verifying the legal next action comes from TASKS, TPM, PERT, KG, and kernel records.
tpm_judge.rationale: TB-20260426-104, STEP-NORTHSTAR-004, and PERT audit node are present and accepted.

evidence_clerk.persona_contract: Evidence clerk accountable for rejecting stale evidence, template-as-proof, and unsupported standards claims.
evidence_clerk.rationale: Audit artifacts are instantiated, evidence files are named, and stale quality-gate residual risk was fixed.

standards_juror.persona_contract: Standards juror accountable for mapping each named standard or method to tailored obligations, evidence, N/A rationale, and residual risks.
standards_juror.rationale: Standards conformance audit maps ISO 12207, ISO 15289, ISO 42001, SSDF, OWASP SAMM, MDA, CMMI, RUP, DDD, TDD/BDD, and SRE.

domain_artifact_juror.persona_contract: Product and artifact juror accountable for proving the artifact BOM is tailored to the product rather than blindly bloated or under-scoped.
domain_artifact_juror.rationale: Artifact BOM audit separates required, deferred, and not-applicable artifacts for this local static productivity app.

verification_juror.persona_contract: Verification juror accountable for ensuring code, UI, scenario, browser, holdout, and transfer testing obligations remain linked to evidence.
verification_juror.rationale: Audit verifies core, static UI, scenario, browser/WYSIWYG, screenshot, and kernel evidence.

adversarial_prosecutor.persona_contract: Adversarial prosecutor accountable for attacking fake rigor, stale evidence, skipped process gates, and official-certification overclaiming.
adversarial_prosecutor.rationale: Stale quality-gate residual risk was corrected; audit explicitly avoids accredited-certification overclaim.

jury_foreperson.persona_contract: Foreperson accountable for final verdict, dissent, residual risks, and legal next action.
jury_foreperson.rationale: No open P0/P1 finding remains for the bounded static demonstrator audit.

verdict.next_action: RUN-CLOSED unless a new change request is opened
